notes.content: [h2]Explosive Odds v1.0.1[/h2][list][*][p]The costume shop has a new tab to view steam achievements in game. It will also show you if you have unlocked them or not. notes.content:

notes.title: Release Date Trailer + Tiny Teams Demo Ts LIVE!
notes.content: [h2]Tiny Teams Demo is LIVE!![/h2][p]Hey all, the [b]Yogscast Tiny Teams event has officially started!![/b] Which means the [b]DEMO IS LIVE[/b] right now up through the 17th of this month! The game has improved a lot since the last demo we think you will have a good time! So get some friends together and try it out. See below for a brief overview list of all the new content.[/p][p][/p][h2]Explosive Odds Releases Sept 24th![/h2][p]Also we are very excited to share that the game will be officially releasing on [b]September 24th[/b]! Check out the latest new release date gameplay trailer: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pVPBOOFBe5Q"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Jump in the demo to experience:[/h3][p]- Lots of visual updates[/p][p]- Minigames[/p][p]- New Abilities[/p][p]- Expanded match options[/p][p]- Voice chat[/p][p]- Draw your own face[/p][p]- Lobby Browser[/p][p]- Steam Integration[/p][p]- Lots of gameplay tweaks and additions[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the Tiny Teams page here: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tinyteams2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/tinyteams2025[/url][/p][p]And of course the Explosive Odds page here: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3674980/Explosive_Odds/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592186/7569faeb52d5c0168fe5b3c5560309f58abacc65.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Next Fest Demo Now Live
notes.content: [h1]The Next Fest Demo Is Live![/h1][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3778760/Explosive_Odds_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The demo will be live for a week after next fest ends so you can play it any time now until the 23rd of this month. We have been working hard on this game and hope that you enjoy it! Please if you do play it feel free to leave feedback, ideas, bug reports or whatever in the discord:  [url="https://discord.gg/y7guXuWJqP"]https://discord.gg/y7guXuWJqP[/url] If you want to help the game out share it with friends and you should be able to leave a review on the games demo page. So if you have a moment it would help out a lot![/p][p][/p][p]Have fun exploding![/p][p]             -Pig Bot Team[/p]

notes.title: Explosive Odds is coming to Steam Next Fest June 9-16!
notes.content:
[h1]Explosive Odds is coming to Next Fest![/h1]
Explosive Odds will be having a [b]free demo during Steam next fest from June 9th - June 16th![/b] Share this around with friends, family, and maybe some random strangers and get ready to go head to head in this explosive game. 🤯 🧨 🤖 💰 

We are very excited to have you all check out the game, we think you will have a lot of fun with it. Remember that this demo is an early look at the full version of the game and will be missing content, features and likely have a few bugs. Once the demo goes live I will be adding a new forum channel in the discord for feedback and ideas. The EO steam discussion board is also open to make posts as well. We would love to hear your thoughts on the game!

Join the discord to stay up to date when the demo drops, find other players, and provide ideas and feedback: https://discord.gg/y7guXuWJqP
